headline.averages: Scoring average over all 16 rounds: +25.5 to par per 9 holes; last 5 rounds +24.8; best 9 +19; by course: Southborough Golf Club +24.8 (13 rounds), Oyster Bay Golf Links +30.5 (1 round), Barefoot Resort - Dye Course +27.5 (1 round), Butter Brook Golf Club +27.0 (1 round).

kpis.label: Handicap Index
kpis.note: ≈ 23 strokes per 9 at Southborough Golf Club · 9-hole rounds included · PCC not applied

headline.trend: Trend now +24.6 per 9 holes (80% noise band +22.8 to +26.4). Three weeks earlier (Aug 28) it was +27.7: 3.0 better now. Its best stretch: +22.9 around Aug 12. At Southborough Golf Club (13 rounds) it is +23.8.
headline.scoring_split: Per 9 holes Shane averages +24.8 to par: +17.3 in strokes to reach the green beyond regulation and +7.4 in putts relative to two per hole (9 rounds with putts tracked on every hole).
headline.lesson_sensitivity: With a round-to-round spread of σ≈7.5 differential points, a change must be about 13.2 differential points (roughly 6.7 strokes per 9 holes) to stand out with 5 rounds each side (about 9.3 with 10, 6.6 with 20).

notes: Scores are compared per 9 holes because most rounds are 9 holes; to_par_per9 puts 9- and 18-hole rounds on one scale.
The Handicap Index is computed by this app under the 2024 WHS rules and is unofficial (no GHIN, PCC = 0).
18Birdies doubles a 9-hole score; WHS adds an expected score for the other nine, so b18_handicap differs from ours.
Rounds with putts_partial = true did not track every putt: leave them out of putting questions.
Most club distances were tapped on the map after the round (logged = after); live-tracked shots are more reliable.

rounds.to_par_per9: to_par scaled to 9 holes (18-hole rounds halved)
rounds.differential: unofficial WHS score differential, 18-hole equivalent (lower is better)
rounds.hi_after: unofficial Handicap Index after this round
rounds.b18_handicap: 18Birdies' own per-round handicap figure, for comparison
rounds.putts: total putts (null when putts were only partly tracked)
rounds.putts_partial: true = putts not tracked on every hole

shots.yards: GPS distance to where the next shot started (includes roll; not carry)
shots.logged: live = tracked during play; after = tapped on the map after the round (less accurate)
shots.invalid: why the distance is unusable (null = usable)

handicap.hi: unofficial Handicap Index after that round
handicap.low_hi: lowest index of the past year
